title: A scoped exam leaves its class out of the student's options too, not only out of the rows
request: After DMG-014 failed on precision by half a point: fix the cause before the role student's second exam.
spec: decision_gate_v1 unchanged; the scope (identifiers left out) unchanged; only what the student may answer inside it.
plan: Find why precision fell under the bar when accuracy was 99.2%.
Restrict the options of every row to the scope's classes.
Check on dev rows with the gate's own verdict, never a copy of it.

decisions.decision: Restrict the options, not the gate.
decisions.why: The gate's precision is the mean over the classes a student answered; a class with no truth in the scope must not be answerable inside it. Changing the gate after a result would make it no gate.

decisions.decision: The spent sealed set is not read again.
decisions.why: A sealed set is read once; the second exam waits for real_v2 from the collector's new tables.

change: dclab_rnd/decision_gate_run.py judge: options without the excluded truths; tests/test_decision_gate.py

findings.defect: In a scoped exam the student could still answer the excluded class.
findings.scenario: DMG-014: a few non-identifier columns answered identifier, a class with no truth in the scope: precision 0 there pulled the mean of five classes to 0.7985.
findings.cause: judge() left the excluded truths out of the rows but passed every row's full option list to the student.
findings.fix: options = [o for o in r['options'] if o not in exclude] before model.answer.

measurements.name: role student on real_v1 dev rows, the gate's own verdict
measurements.result: all options: fail, macro precision 0.7464; identifier removed from the options: pass, macro precision 0.9327

outcome: A scoped exam now asks the student only for the scope's classes. The role student's second exam waits for real_v2.
lessons: A scope has two sides: the rows judged and the answers allowed. Leaving a class out of one and not the other changes what the metric averages over.
risks: real_v2 needs at least 50 sealed new tables from the collector before the second exam.
